name: Alameda Youth Committee (AYC)
org: City of Alameda Recreation and Parks, Underground Teen Center
what_you_do: You work with other teens to create programs and events. You build skills in teamwork, communication and civic engagement.
who_can_apply: Teens. The program page does not give ages or grades.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The program page does not list pay or a fee.
deadline_text: The program page says the committee runs in Fall 2026 and links to online registration. It gives no open or close dates.
how_to_apply: Open the Underground Teen Center page. Use the Alameda Youth Committee link to sign up online with the city.
notes: Ages, grades, meeting times and any fee are not stated on the program page. Call City Hall at 510-747-7400 to ask. The same page describes the Underground Teen Center, where the After Dark program is for middle and high school teens.
